title: Scaffold vpc-baseline module + repo linting + pre-commit hooks
author: Bruno Silva
description: Context: This is the first PR for the AWS VPC Terraform modules (alpha). Goal is to land a minimal but opinionated scaffold that we can iterate on in follow-up PRs (subnet tiering, NAT strategy, endpoints, SG baselines, etc.) without bikeshedding repo hygiene later. What’s included: 1) New module skeleton at modules/vpc-baseline with variables/outputs placeholders and a README template (terraform-docs friendly, but not yet enforced). 2) Repo-level linting / hygiene: .editorconfig, basic terraform fmt guidance, and a Makefile with common targets (fmt, validate, lint) to standardize local runs. 3) Pre-commit hooks: terraform_fmt, terraform_validate, end-of-file-fixer, trailing-whitespace, check-merge-conflict, detect-private-key. Notes: This PR intentionally does NOT implement any VPC resources yet—only the structure and contracts we’ll fill in. The goal is to unblock ENG-4822 work while aligning with Redwood IaC standards (naming/tagging patterns to follow in subsequent PRs). Testing: pre-commit run --all-files; terraform validate on modules/vpc-baseline (module compiles with placeholder variables/outputs); GitHub Actions workflow runs fmt/validate on push. Follow-ups: implement actual aws_vpc/subnets/route tables; add tagging schema and validations; add tflint/checkov; add examples and integration harness.
commits: chore: add pre-commit config and baseline hooks for terraform repos
terraform(vpc-baseline): add module scaffold with variables/outputs + README template
ci: add github actions workflow for terraform fmt/validate
review_conversation: Irene Choi (review): Can we keep the module README structured so docs can mirror it later (Inputs/Outputs/Examples sections)? Also prefer we avoid committing placeholder outputs that we’ll remove. Bruno Silva (author): Yep—updated README to include explicit sections; for outputs I kept only stable identifiers we know we’ll need (vpc_id, subnet_ids) and left others out to avoid churn. Victor Alvarez (review): For main.tf: since it’s empty now, can we at least add a comment block describing intended subnet tiers (public/private/isolated) so it’s clear what this module will become? Bruno Silva (author): Added a header comment outlining the planned topology and pointing to ENG-4822 + upcoming PRs for tiering and NAT. Sahana Iyer (review): Pre-commit is good, but CI should mirror local workflows. Can you add a simple GH action that runs fmt/validate on the module directory? Bruno Silva (author): Added .github/workflows/terraform.yml that runs terraform fmt -check and terraform validate for modules/**. Marcus Lin (review): Please ensure the pre-commit set includes secret detection (detect-private-key) and merge conflict detection. Also, can we avoid suggesting permissive defaults anywhere in README (e.g., 0.0.0.0/0) even as an example. Bruno Silva (author): Added detect-private-key and check-merge-conflict hooks; updated README examples to use RFC1918 CIDRs only and removed any public ingress examples. Irene Choi (final): Looks good as a base. Let’s keep follow-up PRs small and tie each back to the ADR. Approved.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main; branch deleted.
